findings.problem: The explanation for "He keeps quiet about it" uses the heading "For the choirmaster" (Psalm 139:1) as proof that David didn't keep quiet about how he was made: "And the whole psalm is for the choirmaster, no less (Psalm 139:1). That's the opposite of keeping quiet." The text never ties the choirmaster note to David's response in Psalm 139:14. The explanation adds that link, so it should drop the choirmaster lines and rely on Psalm 139:14.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

findings.problem: The explanation for "As foreign soldiers" says "with all that talk of bloodthirsty men." The psalm mentions bloodthirsty men once, in Psalm 139:19, so "all that talk" stretches the text. That fact also has no reference.

rule.text: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.

findings.problem: The explanation for "False" ends with "Believe me, I spent years at the back of a junk drawer, and I STILL got found." This is the punchline from Prep story card 9, nearly word for word, and the baker read it one card earlier. The docs allow callbacks (papa-dorin.md, Joke logic test 6), and answer-explanations.md says explanations must differ from each other. Neither says whether an explanation can repeat a story card's joke word for word.
findings.question: Can an answer explanation reuse a joke from a Prep story card word for word, or must a callback be reworded or point back to the earlier joke?

findings.problem: Many explanations add small new anecdotes about Papa Dorin's bakery life, for example walking into the oven after turning off the lights to sneak a cookie (stop 1 card 14), doing secret taste tests with the lights off (stop 1 card 14), hiding a cookie behind the cookie boxes (stop 2 card 4) and trying to count sprinkles until noon (stop 2 card 8). papa-dorin.md says he can talk freely about his own world "but never adds anything new to them." It also wants self-deprecating jokes. It doesn't say whether one-off comic anecdotes like these count as adding to his world.
findings.question: Do small self-deprecating bakery anecdotes count as "adding anything new" to Papa Dorin's world, or are they allowed as personality?
